audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Yone/Skill/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser against a packet levelChart of Skill/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Skill/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Yone. audit.whatIsWrong: Two real errors plus the naming defect. (a) The page calls Fate Sealed (R) a KNOCKUP in four places — whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid, wants.you[1] ('his R-knockup'). Riot's text says he 'blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it PULLS all enemies hit towards him.' It is a pull, not a displacement upward, and a Mordekaiser who expects to be knocked airborne will misplay the follow-up. (b) Soul Unbound (E) does not merely let him 'snap back' — when it ends, Riot's text says he REPEATS a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit. His burst effectively lands twice, and no line on the page tells the player this. (c) packet.defects: the content layer never uses a real ability name, writing 'W-cleave', 'Q-dash', 'E spirit-rewind', 'Q3 knockup', 'R-knockup' throughout.
audit.why: The damage-repeat is the single reason a trade with Yone goes worse than the health bars suggest mid-trade, and it is the thing the player most needs to plan Indestructible around. Calling the R a knockup is a plain factual error.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'R-knockup' with Fate Sealed's real line-pull in whys[4] and spikes[1].text, and stated the pull explicitly in tldr and report[5].t. Added the Soul Unbound damage-repeat to tldr, report[0].t, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d. Named Mortal Steel, Spirit Cleave, Soul Unbound and Fate Sealed in the fields I touched.
sources: enemyKit R text 'pulls all enemies hit towards him'
enemyKit E text 'repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit', cd 22/19/16/13/10
enemyKit W text 'value is increased by the number of champions hit'

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Soul Unbound with no seconds — 'He snaps back when it ends. R him there.'
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 but only 10s maxed, so the size of the window collapses as the game goes on. That halving is the reason the lane stops being winnable, and the page never showed the number.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d now carry 22s at rank 1 down to 10s, plus the damage-repeat on expiry.

notes: Spirit Cleave's shield scaling with the NUMBER OF CHAMPIONS HIT is the cleanest mechanical argument for why Realm of Death is strong here, and the page had it as a vague 'W team-amp'. It is in Riot's text verbatim, so I used it. One thing I did not touch: the content layer repeatedly says Yone has 'two Q-dashes' / 'double Q-dash'. Riot's Mortal Steel text describes a dash only at 2 stacks, so 'two dashes' is not supported by the kit file, but I could not confirm it is wrong either — left alone and recorded in unverified rather than rewritten on a guess.
